 assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==row['sha256']
cs=json.loads((P/'retained-commands.json').read_text());r=json.loads((P/'retained-result.json').read_text())
for c in cs:
 for s in ['stdout','stderr']:

m=[c for c in cs if 'merge-tree' in c['argv']];assert len(m)==1 and m[0]['exit']==r['exit']==1
